known_reporting_gaps.description: The terminal evaluator summary retains only global prediction_std and target_std; per-task prediction/target spread diagnostics were not persisted across the nine heterogeneous raw-scale endpoints.
known_reporting_gaps.action: Report the global ratio as a compression diagnostic, do not add a post hoc qualification threshold, and do not infer that every task mean-collapsed.

known_reporting_gaps.description: Per-method generation wall time was not persisted for the six search methods; all 891 per-source wall_time_seconds values are null. The overall suite wall time and independent-evaluator scoring wall times are available.
known_reporting_gaps.action: Report NOT_RECORDED; do not infer from file timestamps and do not rerun terminal methods. Future parallel stages now persist one wall_time_seconds value per method.

known_reporting_gaps.description: The terminal selection input retains terminal-cause counts and edit-distance distributions but not per-candidate algorithmic STOP time.
known_reporting_gaps.action: Report exact STOP counts and fractions, keep algorithmic STOP time as NOT_RETAINED, and do not reconstruct it from edit count or wall-clock timestamps.

known_reporting_gaps.description: Four requirements prevent the 18-item minimum benchmark package from being complete: authorized guided comparison, a new outcome-unexposed Evaluation study, its zero-shot/adaptation sequence and complete terminal timing fields.
known_reporting_gaps.action: Keep the packet internal and submission_ready=false; do not bypass the Critic V2 NO-GO, reconstruct terminal timing, or relabel historical GSE232572 as final confirmation.

known_reporting_gaps.description: Seven reproducible provisional figures from six builders exist in PNG, PDF and SVG, but target journal, article type and submission phase have not been selected; publisher-specific dimensions and file rules therefore have not been claimed.
known_reporting_gaps.action: After venue and phase selection, verify the official publisher instructions and regenerate the same frozen evidence if different export dimensions or formats are required.

known_reporting_gaps.description: The 14-study inventory has no study-bound, accountable-human-verified license registry. Converter and preflight output declarations are operational policies rather than independent license determinations.
known_reporting_gaps.action: Report aggregate results and source locators only; do not publicly release study payloads or claim an open-data package until study-specific terms are bound and verified by an accountable human.
